description: Source code for data configuration handling and PCRE regex compilation in lighttpd server.

classes.name: data_config
classes.description: Structure representing configuration data with regex compilation support.

methods.name: data_config_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_config object with default values.

methods.name: data_config_copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a data_config object.

methods.name: data_config_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a data_config object.

methods.name: data_config_pcre_compile
methods.description: Compiles the regex stored in data_config using PCRE, with support for PCRE2 and PCRE.
